name: notjunior
description: Know why, not just what: understand the project you work in, then explain it back. Its mod offers an explain-back check after Claude changes files, and before they ship.

shipCheck.title: Ship check
shipCheck.description: When Claude is about to commit, push, or open a pull request while changes it made this session haven't been explained back: nudge (a reminder, then it runs), hold (refused until you run /notjunior-check), or off.
